title: OL-20261115-7: OPS-1 (ops#11): archived duplicate repos and scratch
body:
**Owner:** ROWAN (identity-bound)
**Trigger:** owner deletes
**Done check:** grep:docs/PROJECT-MEMORY.md::archived duplicates deleted
**Status:** closed

Moved from ultrastable/ops#11. Seven archived duplicates under the org. IDENTITY-BOUND and irreversible: deletion. Default in effect: they stay archived with a SUPERSEDED description.

**Disposition:** gate (owner-bound, 2026-11-20T20:46:50Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** owner field 'ROWAN (identity-bound)' binds this to the owner's own account, money or signature, which no server-side loop holds. Default in effect: the system runs without this step; nothing waits on it. Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes.
